pending.preview.open: Preview browser (apps/server/src/preview/*): needs a headless browser host or the desktop browser channel; server side not ported.
pending.provider.codex.auth-callback.subscribe: Codex ChatGPT sign-in callback listener (CodexAuthCallback.ts): not ported.

partial.device.testHost: A host that is not this machine answers the probe's failure envelope: SSH device hosts are not ported.
partial.device.configure: Remote SSH device hosts are stored but never connected to.
partial.server.getConfig: observability.localTracingEnabled is false (no local trace file is written), and usage-limit sources are not merged. directEndpoints and remoteOpenTargets are served (environment_endpoints.rs).
partial.subscribeServerConfig: No usageLimitSourcesUpdated events (sources are not polled). environmentThemesUpdated is served; directEndpoints/remoteOpenTargets are in the snapshot.
partial.provider.consumeResetCredit: Provider reset credits only; the CLIProxyAPI usage-limit source variant is not ported.
partial.server.updateServer: Answers as an unconfigured build (no launcher IPC channel, so never boot-service managed); the desktop-app path runs over the control channel. Nothing is downloaded or installed.
partial.server.commitDesktopUpdate: As server.updateServer: commits through the desktop app's control channel only.

pending.POST /api/observability/v1/traces: OTLP traces proxy for the browser (BrowserTraceCollector, http.ts): not ported; needs the observability layer.
pending.GET /api/preview-stream/*: Preview browser frame stream: not ported.
pending.POST /api/preview-stream/upload: Preview browser file upload: not ported.

partial.GET *: The static route serves files with validators, the cache policy and the dev redirect, but not the response compression the original's router applies to every response.

pending.html_preview: Listed; fails as the original's HTML renderer does without a browser.
pending.html_render: Listed; fails as the original's HTML renderer does without a browser (htmlRender/headlessChrome.ts not ported).

clientOnly.addProjectBaseDirectory: The original's server never reads it (clients do).
clientOnly.pullRequestMergeMethod: A project-scoped key the clients resolve; the original's server only lists it among the project-scoped keys.
clientOnly.projectAutoPullOverrides: A derived view of projectSettingsOverrides, maintained by the settings model (server_settings_model.rs).
clientOnly.projectAgentBrowserAccessOverrides: A derived view of projectSettingsOverrides, maintained by the settings model (server_settings_model.rs).

partial.responseStreamingMode: Applied for Codex, Claude and Pi (assistant_streaming.rs, at the sink every adapter commits through) and by the OpenCode adapters; the ACP family (acpRegistry, Grok, Antigravity) delivers every delta because acp_adapter keeps its stream state in the projection.

pending.usageLimitSources: Usage-limit sources (UsageLimitSources.ts, cliproxyApi.ts) are not polled or streamed.
pending.pullRequestStackActions: Native stack scope of pull request actions (githubStackActions.ts, githubStackRebase.ts): not ported.
